summary: std/json: the stream Decoder (`json.decoder()`) is linear in a value sent in small pieces
details: the stream Decoder (`json.decoder()`) is linear in a value sent in small pieces; it rescanned the whole unfinished value on every write (480 KB in 64 byte writes took 1.6 s, now 3 ms).
